museum_aaa_featured.name: Endless Museum — Featured AAA Pass
museum_aaa_featured.truth: An artifact becomes an exhibition only when its surrounding permissions are designed with equal care.
museum_aaa_featured.qfep_connection: The sequence moves from fixed reference, through disputed calibration and materially hosted becoming, to a plural family of solids: order becomes a parameter rather than a command.
museum_aaa_featured.description: Four measured dressing rooms and one synthesis gallery test the production contract for featured museum artifacts.
learning_objectives: Recognize the origin as a chosen spatial reference
Manipulate lambda as a disputed calibration rather than a neutral fact
Recognize when a control requires a museum-supplied host at a usable height
Walk the complete perimeter of a large artifact family
Read wall, pedestal, table, and platform staging as different contracts
